data.narrative:
Determinant Materials is a Seed-stage frontier-technology company in the Climate & Energy sector, founded by Nikhil R. Gupta. The valuation universe comprises one public comparable (LNZA) and eight private peers, including Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix. The company has raised $2.5M to date.

The analysis applies a stage-progression methodology, which is the applicable triangulation approach given data constraints. Using total capital raised ($2M proxy) as the base value and applying a typical Seed-to-next-stage multiplier of 2.5x yields an implied valuation of $6M. A peer-median approach was not viable; while eight same-sector peers exist in Climate & Energy, none satisfied minimum thresholds (≥3 datapoints) when filtered by stage, adjacency, or valuation tier, making a narrow-set median unreliable.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $5M to $7M, with a median estimate of $6M. The narrow methodological foundation—relying on a single applicable method—represents the primary uncertainty. Refinement would require either additional same-stage or adjacent-stage comparable valuations within Climate & Energy, or disclosure of more granular financial metrics (burn rate, unit economics, or revenue traction) to support alternative approaches. The range reflects standard Seed-stage step-up mechanics rather than company-specific operational data.
